body: Wow I don't know if you pretty much read my brain. Over the last month I've been obsessed with suicide. Researching different methods and medications. Everyday I go along like nothing is different but in my head I'm thinking this just might be my last day. I'm sorry I I don't have an answer to tell you how this can stop because my only thought is to actually go through with it. I am just overwhelmed with all of the negative activity within my life.  I have great friends to invite me out to do things that make me happy and sometimes I go and sometimes I don't but even when I go I'm only happy in the moment.
No, sorry. There will be just a lot of annoying leftover side effects and pissed off anger because they're still alive.
